tool.name: RADAR-PD Utility: Live Snapshot Analysis
tool.description: analyze one immutable provisional scan against a reviewed nuclear reference
tool.command: touch '$result_bundle' '$response_cache_output' '$console_output' && trap "chmod a+r '$result_bundle' '$response_cache_output' '$console_output' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && python -m gpx_recipe.live.galaxy_worker '$packet' worker '$result_bundle' '$response_cache_output' --preparation-evidence '$preparation_provenance' #slurp #if $response_cache --cache '$response_cache' #slurp #end if > '$console_output' 2>&1

configfiles.configfile: #import json #set records = [] #if $preparation_evidence #for certificate in $preparation_evidence #set dataset = $certificate.unsanitized #set job = getattr($dataset, 'creating_job', None) #set markers = [line for line in str(getattr($job, 'stdout', '')).splitlines() if line.startswith('[RADAR PREPARATION CERTIFICATE] ')] #set record = dict(certificate_path=str($certificate), tool_id=str(getattr($job, 'tool_id', '')), tool_version=str(getattr($job, 'tool_version', '')), job_state=str(getattr($job, 'state', '')), dataset_state=str(getattr($dataset, 'state', '')), dataset_deleted=bool(getattr($dataset, 'deleted', True)), dataset_purged=bool(getattr($dataset, 'purged', True)), job_stdout='\n'.join($markers)) #set ignored = $records.append($record) #end for #end if $json.dumps(dict(schema='radar-galaxy-preparation-evidence/v1', records=$records), sort_keys=True)

param.name: packet
param.label: Reviewed source, observations and magnetic settings

param.name: preparation_evidence
param.label: Native preparation origin receipts (NOVA supplies these automatically)

tool.help:
NOVA captures and reviews the provisional scan and nuclear reference before submitting this worker. Cumulative snapshots replace the likelihood; they are not added to one another. Cache reuse requires matching observations geometry, fixed reference, magnetic settings and scientific implementation.
The result reports conditional uncertainty and sampling diagnostics. It does not establish a phase, calibrated stopping decision or a converged conventional Rietveld refinement. Published GPXs represent the verified displayed parameter values; the original source is preserved. No model API credential is required.
Prepared model inputs use the same creating-job evidence contract as Model Campaign. A receipt alone does not qualify another geometry, bank or data set.
